add.description: Paste one or more emails or domains, separated by commas, semicolons, spaces or new lines. Matching people can sign in right away; matching guests become internal users.
add.empty: Enter at least one valid email or domain.
add.inputHint: For example: an@company.com, @company.com or company.com (the whole domain).

access.description: Anyone whose email or domain is on this list can sign in as an internal user. Removing an entry signs matching people out on their next request.

list.empty: The allowlist is empty: only super admins can sign in.
list.selfHint: You cannot remove your own email.
list.title: Allowlist
list.users: {count, plural, =0 {No users yet} one {# user} other {# users}}

access.publicDomainWarning: {domain} is a public email domain: adding it lets every {domain} user sign in. Prefer adding individual emails instead.

remove.description: Users matching this entry are signed out on their next request, unless they still match another entry, are super admins or are Space members (they then become guests).
remove.impactGuest: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} will become guests (still Space members).
remove.impactLosing: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} will lose access.
remove.impactMatched: {count, plural, =0 {No active user matches this entry.} one {# active user matches this entry.} other {# active users match this entry.}}
remove.title: Remove {value}?

testEmail.description: Send a test email to check the SMTP settings. Leave the recipient empty to send it to yourself.
testEmail.invalidEmail: The recipient email is not valid.
testEmail.title: Test email

forbidden.description: Only super admins can open the Administration pages.
forbidden.title: You don't have access

actions.selfHint: You cannot deactivate yourself or remove your own super admin role.

confirm.grantDescription: {name} will be able to manage the allowlist, users and every Space.
confirm.lockDescription: {name} loses every role at once and is signed out on their next request. You can reactivate them later.
confirm.revokeDescription: {name} will no longer be a super admin. If they are not on the allowlist, they become a guest or are signed out.
confirm.unlockDescription: {name} can sign in again if they still match the allowlist or are a Space member.

users.description: Everyone who has signed in to KB, guests included, and why they can still sign in.
